sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.1.40
- Added 1-year store credit expiration support across transactional email templates and client-side previewer
- Configured individual FIFO cashback expiration dates calculated 1 year from the qualifying order date
- Scheduled automated 30-day pre-expiry warning Action Scheduler jobs (335 days post-grant) to drive repeat skin conversions before expiration
